kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From جَبَل (jabal, “mountain”) + طَارِق (ṭāriq, “of Tariq”). Literally, “mountain of Tariq”, named after Tariq ibn Ziyad, who led the Umayyad conquest of Hispania
g: Gibraltar (a peninsula, city, and overseas territory of the United Kingdom, at the southern end of Iberia)
Gibraltar, Strait of Gibraltar (a strait connecting the Mediterranean to the Atlantic between Gibraltar and Morocco; in full, Strait of Gibraltar)
